description.value: Creekside Community Recreation Centre is a City of Vancouver-operated facility situated in the Olympic Village neighbourhood at Athletes Way, adjacent to False Creek. The three-storey building sits at the heart of a district purpose-built for the 2010 Winter Olympics and is now a hub for the surrounding community. Its location along one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors makes it a natural landmark for touring cyclists navigating the False Creek seawall route.
